title: SM ST10C
text: 离散时间或连续时间同步电机 ST10C 静态励磁系统，带自动电压调节器，输入 10 路、输出 1 路；按 {Sample time (-1 for inherited)} 指定模块采样时间；{Initial field voltage, Efd0 (pu)} 指定初始输出电压、{Initial terminal voltage, Vt0 (pu)} 指定初始机端电压、{Initial terminal current, It0 (pu)} 指定初始机端电流、{Resistive component of load compensation, R_C (pu)} 指定补偿电阻、{Reactance component of load compensation, X_C (pu)} 指定补偿电抗、{Regulator input filter time constant, T_R (s)} 调节器时间常数、{Regulator gain, K_R (pu)} 调节器增益、{Voltage regulator denominator (lag) time constant 1, T_B1 (s)} 调节器滞后时间常数、{Voltage regulator numerator (lead) time constant 1, T_C1 (s)} 调节器超前时间常数、{Voltage regulator denominator (lag) time constant 2, T_B2 (s)} 调节器滞后时间常数、{Voltage regulator numerator (lead) time constant 2, T_C2 (s)} 调节器超前时间常数、{UEL regulator denominator (lag) time constant 1, T_UB1 (s)} 指定 UEL 调节器滞后时间常数、{UEL regulator numerator (lead) time constant 1, T_UC1 (s)} 指定 UEL 调节器超前时间常数、{UEL regulator denominator (lag) time constant 2, T_UB2 (s)} 指定 UEL 调节器滞后时间常数、{UEL regulator numerator (lead) time constant 2, T_UC2 (s)} 指定 UEL 调节器超前时间常数、{OEL regulator denominator (lag) time constant 1, T_OB1 (s)} 指定 OEL 调节器滞后时间常数、{OEL regulator numerator (lead) time constant 1, T_OC1 (s)} 指定 OEL 调节器超前时间常数、{OEL regulator denominator (lag) time constant 2, T_OB2 (s)} 指定 OEL 调节器滞后时间常数、{OEL regulator numerator (lead) time constant 2, T_OC2 (s)} 指定 OEL 调节器超前时间常数、{Maximum regulator output, V_Rmax (pu)} 调节器最大输出、{Minimum regulator output, V_Rmin (pu)} 调节器最小输出、{Maximum PSS regulator output, V_RSmax (pu)} 指定 PSS 调节器最大输出、{Minimum PSS regulator output, V_RSmin (pu)} 指定 PSS 调节器最小输出、{Alternate PSS input locations (V_S)} 指定 PSS 输入位置 Summation point at output、{Alternate OEL input locations (V_OEL)} 指定 OEL 输入位置 Summation point at voltage、{Alternate UEL input locations (V_UEL)} 指定 UEL 输入位置 Summation point at voltage、{Alternate SCL input locations (V_SCL)} 指定 SCL 输入位置 Summation point at voltage、{Rectifier loading factor proportional to commutating reactance, K_C (pu)} 指定整流器负载系数、{Equivalent time constant for rectifier bridge, T_1 (s)} 指定整流桥的时间常数、{Potential circuit (voltage) gain coefficient, K_P (pu)} 指定电势电路电压增益系数、{Potential circuit (current) gain coefficient, K_I (pu)} 指定电势电路电流增益系数、{Reactance associated with the potential source, X_L (pu)} 指定电势源电抗、{Potential circuit phase angle (degrees)} 指定电势电路相位角、{Maximum available exciter voltage, V_Bmax (pu)} 指定励磁机电压上限、{Power source selector} 指定电源选择器 Position A: power source derived from generator terminal，按实例取值。
